title: Focus discipline
desc: Focus returns to the input box after actions, and the transcript is fully keyboard-navigable.

title: Hover without shift
desc: Message actions appear on hover without shifting the layout.

title: Parallel tools
desc: Several tools running at once render as separate rows, each with its own state.

title: Oversized results
desc: Large tool output shows a short summary inline. The full content loads on demand via content_full_ref.

title: Task tree
desc: Sub-agents and nested work render as a collapsible tree.

title: Artifact pane
desc: Generated documents open in a side pane next to the chat.

title: Selection-scoped edit
desc: Select part of an artifact and request a change scoped to that selection.

title: Mobile ergonomics
desc: Keyboard avoidance, safe areas, and touch target sizes for phones.

title: Long-transcript performance
desc: The transcript stays smooth with thousands of messages, via virtualization.
